svg.aria-label: Intention, core concepts on the frame of AN 6.63: contact is the source of deeds; greed, hate and delusion, or contentment, love and understanding, are their roots; intention is the deed; it acts through body, speech and mind; results follow. Below: the path that trains intention, how East Asian Buddhism widens it, how Shinto and Reiki purify the heart, and two modern lenses from philosophy and psychology.
svg.title: Intention Core Concepts Diagram v1
svg.text: cetanā — “It is intention that I call deeds.” AN 6.63
